newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco El Teniente mine output hit by weather.
newsitem.headline: Codelco El Teniente mine output hit by weather.

text.p: Chilean state copper company Codelco's El Teniente mine has closed its concentrator and another plant as heavy snowfall has blocked access roads to the buildings, said an official at the division.
"We are having problems with carrying out our activities... mainly with bringing workers up and down for the turns," said spokesman Rodrigo Rivas.
The Colon concentrator and the pit's mill are both closed while other sections of the division are working at less than usual capacity, said Rivas.
But the underground pit and the Caletones smelter have been working normally with workers carrying out longer-than-usual shifts, said officials.

The smelter has been kept operating by using stocks of concentrates from El Teniente as well as concentrates mined in Codelco's Andina division which have been transported to El Teniente for processing.
"We hope to normalize production today and tomorrow. We are clearing the roads but if it snows again the situation will be difficult," he said.
Violent storms have lashed central Chile since Thursday causing flooding and landslides, while heavy snowfall has blocked roads throughout the Andes.
